en.title: 'Our Happy Good Day' Rating Hits 10.4% — Yoon Da-hoon's Role as Go Dae-chi
en.summary: Yoon Da-hoon plays Go Dae-chi, president of Kangsu Construction, in KBS1's daily drama 'Our Happy Good Day.' Go Dae-chi is Jo Seong-jun's high school classmate and the father of two sons, Go-gyeol and Go Min-ho, driving both the company's power struggles and the family's conflicts.
